subject: Oceanography
title: Mass Extinctions in the Ocean
description: A quick, practical guide to Mass Extinctions in the Ocean.

hook.text: Five mass extinctions have wiped out most marine life—and the ocean's geology records every one.

buildup.text: The Permian extinction (252 million years ago) killed 96% of marine species—the worst ever.

discovery.text: Massive volcanic eruptions warmed the climate, deoxygenated oceans, and poisoned marine habitats.

twist.text: After each extinction, marine life rebounded—often more diverse than before.

climax.text: Today's ocean changes (warming, acidification, deoxygenation) mirror conditions before past extinctions.

punchline.text: The ocean has died before—and always recovered. But it takes millions of years.
